blueprints.title: Agent loop
blueprints.use_when: Building the loop that calls a model, runs the tools it asks for and repeats until it stops; or an agent runs away, loops, or will not stop on its own

blueprints.title: RAG baseline
blueprints.use_when: Answers have to come from a document corpus the model was not trained on, the corpus changes, or answers must cite their sources; retrieval is being set up, or the model hallucinates and cannot attribute what it says

blueprints.title: Tool design
blueprints.use_when: An agent has more than one tool and picks the wrong one, sends malformed arguments, or misreads what a tool returned; tool schemas, descriptions and return shapes are being written or reworked
